meta.name: apollo-upgrade-migration
meta.description:
Manage Apollo.io SDK upgrades.
Use when upgrading Apollo API versions, migrating to new endpoints,
or updating deprecated API usage.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo upgrade", "apollo migration",
"update apollo api", "apollo breaking changes", "apollo deprecation".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 升级旧版 SDK 调用到新接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的项目还在用旧版 SDK 需要适配新接口
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade legacy SDK calls to new APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project relies on an old SDK version and needs to adapt to new APIs

howto.what: Claude 会规划并执行 Apollo.io API 升级,先做升级前审计,再提供兼容层、功能开关控制的上线、并行测试验证和清理方案,以处理破坏性变更与弃用接口。
howto.when: 当你说“apollo upgrade”“apollo migration”等触发词,或要求处理 Apollo API 版本升级、接口迁移、弃用更新时触发。

say.text: 帮我升级 Apollo API 到新版本
say.note: 会先审计并给出迁移计划

say.text: Apollo 接口要迁移,怎么处理?
say.note: 会产出兼容层和并行测试方案

say.text: 检查我们代码里的弃用 Apollo 调用
say.note: 会输出审计结果和清理步骤

howto.what_en: Claude will plan and execute Apollo.io API upgrades: run a pre-upgrade audit, provide a compatibility layer, feature-flag controlled rollout, parallel testing verification, and cleanup procedures to handle breaking changes and deprecated endpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade Apollo API versions, migrate to new endpoints, or update deprecated API usage, or when you say phrases like "apollo upgrade" or "apollo migration".

say_en.text: Help me upgrade the Apollo API to a new version.
say_en.note: It will run an audit and create a migration plan.

say_en.text: How should we handle the Apollo endpoint migration?
say_en.note: It provides a compatibility layer and parallel testing plan.

say_en.text: Check our code for deprecated Apollo calls.
say_en.note: It outputs the audit results and cleanup steps.
